title: Expanding Our Tomato Plots This Spring
author: Jane Smith
content: This spring we expanded our mini farm plots to make room for a new batch of heirloom tomatoes. Here is a look at how the season is shaping up so far, from seedlings to soil prep. We started with a dozen varieties, including Brandywine and Cherokee Purple, and built three new raised beds along the south fence line where they'll get full sun through the afternoon.
